question: You are asked to display your network devices using the Juniper Mist GUI as a single solution. Your network is made up of a wireless infrastructure of only Juniper APs and the wired infrastructure has a mix of Juniper and non-Juniper switches. Your solution must ensure that all devices are displayed in the Juniper Mist GUI. Given this scenario, how would you accomplish this task? A. Use Wired Assurance with the Monitoring option. B. Use WiFi Management and Assurance with LLDP enabled on all switches. C. Use Juniper Mist Marvis Actions. D. Use Juniper Mist Asset Visibility.
Which two configuration elements are available in a WLAN template? (Choose two.) A. organizations B. template policies C. radio management D. WLANs

Which two statements describe port profiles? (Choose two.) A. They include a set of interface configurations. B. They can be assigned to multiple ports. C. They include a set of routing configurations. D. They must be assigned to only one port.

Which statement about microservices is correct? A. Microservices are developed as a suite of applications and rely on developers to deliver updates to the entire suite at once. B. Microservices must share a common database to ensure data integrity. C. Microservices are designed to be dependent on each other to ensure that if one process fails, the remaining processes will not continue to operate. D. Microservices communicate with each other using APIs.

Which two statements are true about switch configurations at the site level? (Choose two.) A. Switch configurations at the site level are an additional way to apply a switch template to a specific site. B. Switch configurations at the site level are required to manually configure individual switches. C. Site-level switch configurations override org-level templates. D. Organizational-level templates override site-level switch configurations.

Which statement about Marvis Minis is correct? A. Marvis Minis is Juniper's onsite technical support team that troubleshoots enterprise access points. B. Marvis provides Marvis Actions to simulate user connections. C. Marvis Minis works with Juniper Mist AI to validate network configuration to optimize user experiences. D. Marvis is an LLMsc that designs network infrastructure.

Which two statements are correct about the switch configuration hierarchy in Juniper Mist? (Choose two.) A. The switch configuration cannot be managed at the organization level. B. The switch templates exist at the site level. C. The switch templates exist at the organization level. D. The switch-specific configuration cannot override switch templates.

Which two protocols does Marvis Minis automatically validate? (Choose two.) A. Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) B. Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) C. Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) D. Network Time Protocol (NTP)
Which three categories of alert types are available in Juniper Mist? (Choose three.) A. Marvis B. Users C. Site D. Infrastructure E. Security
What is required for Marvis Minis to operate? A. Premium Analytics subscription B. WAN Assurance subscription C. WLAN template D. minimum AP firmware
How often does Marvis Minis execute automatic validations? A. every hour B. every day C. every 30 minutes D. every week
Which Juniper device is used in Routing Assurance? A. SRX Series firewalls B. EX Series switches C. Session Smart Routers D. MX Series
What does the AI-driven RRM in Juniper Mist Wireless Assurance optimize? A. user interfaces B. band steering C. SSID naming conventions D. radio resource settings
Click the Exhibit button. Referring to the exhibit, how many Marvis for Wireless subscriptions have been purchased and onboarded? A. 82 B. 103 C. 21 D. 61
Click the Exhibit button. Referring to the exhibit, which percentage of Coverage was unsuccessful? A. 79% B. 15% C. 9% D. 21%
You are creating a new site in the UI. What are three required configuration settings in this scenario? (Choose three.) A. RF Template B. Site Name C. Location D. Country E. Active Hours
Which Juniper Mist feature provides application forwarding path details? A. Platform Insights B. Router Insights C. Forwarding Insights D. WAN Edge Insights

When viewing the LATEST UPDATES on the Marvis Actions page, you see an action labeled AI VALIDATED. What does this status mean? A. The issue is resolved but was not manually marked resolved. B. The issue was identified and resolved entirely by Marvis. C. The issue is unresolved. D. The issue was marked resolved by an administrator.

Which two statements are correct about Juniper Mist subscriptions? (Choose two.) A. If a device fails and is removed from the network, the subscription will automatically apply to the new device when added. B. If a device fails and is removed from the network, you must manually transfer the subscription to the new device before installing. C. Subscriptions are associated with a specific device serial number. D. Subscriptions are not associated with a specific device serial number.
Which Juniper Mist dashboard feature uses the ROAMINGOF element? A. conversational assistant B. Marvis Query Language C. Wireless SLE D. Marvis Minis
What are two ways to claim an Access Point with Juniper Mist? (Choose two.) A. activation code B. MAC address C. claim code D. serial number
Which two wired elements would be configured using an organization-level template? (Choose two.) A. DNS settings B. VLAN C. host name D. role
Which Juniper Mist feature provides visibility into BGP operations for MX Series routers? A. Routing Assurance B. Wired Assurance C. Access Assurance D. WAN Assurance
Which two subscriptions are required to use Marvis Minis? (Choose two.) A. WiFi Management and Assurance B. vBLE Engagement C. Marvis for Wireless D. Premium Analytics
